summary: Every rendered number on report.md, dashboard_data.json and the manifest matches the registry exactly, the country figures sum to net_revenue (35741.52) and 27/57 = 0.473684; but release/dashboard_data.json labels the CLM-NET-PL card (11,181.67) as DE and the CLM-NET-DE card (11,032.61) as PL, so a dashboard reader sees the two country revenues attributed to the wrong countries, and neither release gate compares labels.
